classification: post-hoc descriptive analysis; specified after original study outcomes

controlled.permitted_data: validation.csv.gz and only the original condition traces it names
controlled.forbidden_data: train_exploration.csv.gz and held_out_test.csv.gz; no new threshold selection
controlled.matching: arrival and query timestamps, occupancy, event origin mask; IPID space alone changes
controlled.qname_equivalent: FRAG1 schedule IPIDs also expand; equal query timestamps remain matched
controlled.primary: continuous and bursty sweep vs matched benign, 4 target volumes; AP for entropy and uniqueness, attack alert, benign trigger, FNR, J, delta J vs B2
controlled.secondary: fixed, duplicate sweep, random negative control; report separately
controlled.benign_only_traces: score and retain them; omit from paired effects because they have no attack mate in validation
controlled.inference: 5000 paired-trace bootstrap samples within each cell; equal cell weights for macro; descriptive intervals only

orphan.data: all 320 completed factorial confirmatory runs, ips_outside.pcapng only, before enforcement
orphan.capture_order: Stable chronological sort by kernel capture timestamp; retain every scoped frame and audit file-order timestamp inversions. Original record-order assumption failed in r001; no outcome-based run exclusions.
orphan.order_sensitivity: Also replay file record order, clamping backward timestamps only for that diagnostic. Report its maximum orphan ratio; do not silently rely on timestamp sorting.
orphan.packet_identity: Report unique forged packet signatures and their repeated capture observations separately; a repeated hash is not automatically a duplicate physical send.
orphan.scope: sources 10.82.0.100 and 10.82.0.200 to resolver 10.81.0.53; all protocols including non-DNS occupancy
orphan.definition: fraction of non-initial fragment observations in the trailing window lacking a first fragment observed within 2 s before that tail or after that tail by the current evaluation time; matching is causal and remembered for the tail's residence in the window
orphan.denominator: all observed non-initial fragments in window; empty window -> ratio 0, active false
orphan.head: offset zero with MF set; do not use unfragmented datagrams as first-fragment evidence
orphan.thresholds: fixed here, not selected from runtime outcomes
orphan.timing: ratio at query start and peak ratio/any activation during query interval; update matching when heads arrive, score tail enforcement at ingress
orphan.query_clock: wall clock from per-trial wall_ns-mono_ns offset plus query_start/end_mono_ns; report offset spread and check coverage
orphan.clock_guard: When offset spread exceeds 1 ms, accept interval ratios only if orphan ratio is identically zero over the entire capture in both timestamp and record order. Otherwise stop: exact query alignment is unresolved.
orphan.primary_comparison: B0_OFF attack vs benign at each rate, paired by recreated-run replicate; AP and fixed-rule alert rates
orphan.other_policies: descriptive separate policy strata; their feedback and query schedules change observed traffic
orphan.claim_scope: offline baseline replay only; no enforced orphan policy or counterfactual malicious-answer/cache-insertion rates
